name: Ferrari 488 GTE Evo (2023) - AF Corse #21
_notes: Visuals, layout.json and textures are generated by Tools/External/LMU/import_lmu_vehicle.py from the Le Mans Ultimate Ferrari_488GTE_LM_2023 with the 21_AFCorseLM livery (AF Corse #21, Le Mans).

From the LMU physics files (F488GTE_lm.hdv / F488GTE_lm_Engine.ini): mass 1385 kg (no fuel), 52.5% rear, inertia, rev limit 7500 rpm, full-throttle and closed-throttle torque tables (681 Nm @ 5000 rpm), default 6-speed set (35/13, 33/16, 27/16, 27/19, 25/21, 24/24, final 50/15 x 21/23), 6800 rpm upshift (UpshiftAlgorithm 0.9067), diff preload/power/coast, default spring and anti-roll bar settings, 18 deg steering lock, front/rear brake torque ratio.
Derived: CoM height = hdv CGHeight 0.303 m + ~0.06 m default ride height; engine friction is a linear fit of the closed-throttle column; engine inertia includes the clutch.

Tires and aero are generated by Tools/External/LMU/export_lmu_physics.py from the car's .tbc tire (compound 0 "Soft") and .hdv aero map: tires.json holds the slip curves, load sensitivity, peak slip, camber and speed effects, aero.json the front/rear wing, body and diffuser maps. Default setup used: front wing 0, rear wing P4 (3), ride heights 0.055/0.065 m, tire pressures 140 kPa, camber -2.5/-2.0 deg.

Estimated (not in the LMU data used here): damper rates at 0.45/0.75 of critical, suspension travel, wheel inertias and brake torque magnitude (same deceleration as the GT3 R per kg). Not modelled: tire temperature, pressure grip, wear, wet grip, pneumatic trail / aligning torque, tire vertical compliance, aero rotation damping, drafting, flaps and fenders.
